description: Create a new Sentry project for an app or service and provision its DSN (client key) for SDK setup. Optionally links a connected repository with a root code mapping. Returns the project, its DSN, whether the repository linked, and the Sentry signals its platform supports, each with a docs link.

name.description: Display name, usually the app or service name.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: Sentry platform ID, e.g. `javascript-react`, `javascript-nextjs`, `node`, `python-django`, `apple-ios`, `android`, `dotnet`. Omit if unsure.
The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

repository.description: Repository to link, as `owner/repo`. Must already be connected to the organization through a VCS integration.

anyOf.description: Project slug. Sentry derives one from the name when omitted.

name: create_project

dsn.description: Public DSN (SENTRY_DSN) for SDK initialization, or null when key setup failed.

docsUrl.description: Sentry setup guide for the platform.

signals.description: Core signals the platform supports and the organization has enabled.

recommended.description: Set on signals the SDK's default setup turns on.

setup.description: Setup knowledge for the project's platform, or null without one.

title: Create Project
